title: Orders
buyerSubtitle: Your organization's orders with all vendors.
rangeReversed: The start date must not be after the end date.
emptyBuyer: Orders you submit to your vendors appear here.
emptyVendor: Orders from your buyers appear here.
notFoundDescription: It doesn't exist or belongs to another organization.
heading: Order <mono>{number}</mono>
placedDescription: {vendor} has your order. Status updates and messages appear here.
rejectedNote: The vendor rejected this order. The reason is in the history below.
cancelledNote: This order won't be delivered. The reason is in the history below.
asSubmitted: Exactly as reviewed and submitted; later price changes don't affect this order.
staleNote: The order was refreshed — check its current state and try again if still needed.
uncertainNote: We couldn't confirm the result. Trying again is safe: it won't be applied twice.

thread.title: Messages
thread.readOnly: This order is closed and the partners are no longer connected, so the thread is read-only.
thread.label: Message {name}
thread.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
thread.uncertain: Press Send again to retry safely — the message won't be posted twice.

request.vendorHint: The order can't be dispatched until you approve or decline the request.
request.buyerHint: The vendor will approve or decline your request.
request.approveDescription: The order is cancelled with the buyer's reason and reserved stock is restored. This can't be undone.
request.declineDescription: The order stays accepted. {buyer} sees your reason.
request.withdrawDescription: The order stays accepted and {vendor} can dispatch it.

buyerActions.restricted: Your organization lets only owners and admins cancel orders.
buyerActions.cancelDescription: {vendor} hasn't accepted it yet, so it's cancelled right away. This can't be undone.
buyerActions.requestDescription: {vendor} has accepted the order and decides whether to cancel it.

reorder.title: Reorder {number}
reorder.description: Adds this order's products to your cart with their original quantities at today's prices. Nothing is ordered until you review and submit.
reorder.replacementDescription: Prepares a new order linked to this cancelled one, starting from its products at today's prices. Nothing is ordered until you review and submit.
reorder.nothingAvailable: None of these products can be ordered right now.
reorder.existingCart: {count, plural, one {Your cart for this vendor already has {countText} product.} other {Your cart for this vendor already has {countText} products.}}
reorder.added: {count, plural, one {Added {countText} product to your cart} other {Added {countText} products to your cart}}
reorder.addedSkipped: {count, plural, one {Added {countText} product to your cart} other {Added {countText} products to your cart}} — {skipped} unavailable
